methods.name: SAMLS
methods.summary: SAMLS is a feature fusion model adapted from the Segment Anything Model (SAM). It uses a dual-encoder architecture (RGB branch and DEM branch) with a cross-branch attention mechanism to fuse optical and terrain features, and employs an anchor-based prompter for automatic landslide identification.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a novel feature fusion model called SAMLS.
